# The console app, built with xsdk (https://github.com/xenosworks/xsdk) in WSL:
#   cmake -S app -B build/xbox -G Ninja -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=<xsdk>/cmake/xsdk.cmake
# build_xbox.ps1 does this. The PC tools are the top-level CMakeLists.txt.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(AvatarThriftStore C CXX ASM)

# The app's own kernel/XAM imports, as thunks generated by xsdk's tool.
file(STRINGS imports.txt import_lines REGEX "^[^#].*[^ ]")
set(import_sources)
foreach(line IN LISTS import_lines)
    string(REGEX REPLACE "^[^ ]+ +[^ ]+ +([^ ]+).*" "\\1" name "${line}")
    list(APPEND import_sources "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/imports/${name}.S")
endforeach()
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT ${import_sources}
    COMMAND python3 "${XSDK_ROOT}/tools/gen_imports.py" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/imports.txt"
            "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/imports"
    DEPENDS imports.txt "${XSDK_ROOT}/tools/gen_imports.py"
    VERBATIM)

add_executable(AvatarThriftStore
    main.cpp
    gfx.cpp
    items.cpp
    profiles.cpp
    storage.cpp
    stb_image_impl.cpp
    ../core/account.cpp
    ../core/avatar_item.cpp
    ../core/profile.cpp
    ../core/rsa.cpp
    ../core/sha1.cpp
    ../core/stfs.cpp
    ../core/stfs_package.cpp
    ${import_sources})
target_include_directories(AvatarThriftStore PRIVATE ../third_party)
target_compile_features(AvatarThriftStore PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_compile_options(AvatarThriftStore PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-O2 -Wall -Wextra>)

# Packed into AvatarThriftStore.xex as xsdk_add_xex (xsdk/cmake/xsdk.cmake)
# does, but with the app's own title id: xsdk's default, 5853444B ("XSDK"), is
# shared by every xsdk title, and dashboards such as Aurora keep covers and
# settings per title id. 41565453 is "AVTS"; not AAAAAAAA, the unlocked items' id.
set(AVATAR_THRIFT_STORE_TITLE_ID 41565453)
set_property(TARGET AvatarThriftStore APPEND PROPERTY LINK_DEPENDS
    "${XSDK_ROOT}/build/libxsdk.a" "${XSDK_ROOT}/src/xsdk.ld")
add_custom_command(TARGET AvatarThriftStore POST_BUILD
    COMMAND sh -c "'${CMAKE_OBJDUMP}' -d '$<TARGET_FILE:AvatarThriftStore>' | python3 '${XSDK_ROOT}/tools/xenia_scan.py'"
    COMMAND python3 "${XSDK_ROOT}/tools/elf2xex.py" --title-id ${AVATAR_THRIFT_STORE_TITLE_ID}
            "$<TARGET_FILE:AvatarThriftStore>" "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:AvatarThriftStore>/AvatarThriftStore.xex"
    VERBATIM)
